name: v3.5.3
body:
## What's Changed
* feat: pass an OIDC token into commands by @yndu13 in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1482
* fix: forward source IP context to ossutil by @PanPanZou in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1489
* fix: reuse source metadata for OSS transfer progress by @PanPanZou in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1487
* fix: respect AI mode for MCP authentication errors by @PanPanZou in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1488
* feat: integrate Bailian standalone CLI binaries by @api-tool-agent in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1486
* feat: bridge dgate as an external CLI command by @huangjunying-229 in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1492
* refactor(pricing): migrate CLI and plugin runtime to SDK v2 by @api-tool-agent in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1494
* fix: reuse preinstalled ossutil and isolate installation files by @PanPanZou in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1490
* feat: add CLI telemetry by @AllyW in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1493
* feat: verify plugin and upgrade artifacts by @yndu13 in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1474
* fix: refine environment detection by @AllyW in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1501

## New Contributors
* @huangjunying-229 made their first contribution in https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/pull/1492

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/aliyun/aliyun-cli/compare/v3.5.2...v3.5.3
